name: hooks-write-a-sin
setup: git init -q && git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -q --allow-empty -m init
mkdir -p .commandments && printf '%s\n' '<?php' 'return function ($config): void {' '    $config->paths("src");' '};' > .commandments/config.php

mkdir -p src && printf '%s\n' '<?php' '' 'namespace App;' '' 'final class Order' '{' '    public function hides(): void' '    {' '    }' '' '    public function total(array $data): int' '    {' '        return $data["total"] ?? 0;' '    }' '}' > src/Order.php
